mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the care-team gating fact allows the model to construct a Permitted GetRecord operation for a clinician with no CareTeamMembership row, directly violating FR-004 and the LeastPrivilege invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamGatingViolation { some op: Operation, u: User, r: Record | op.opCaller = u and u.role = Clinician and op.opKind = GetRecord and op.opOutcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.ctmClinician = u and m.ctmRecord = r) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the backward-link fact allows AuditEntry atoms that do not correspond to any Operation, breaking the one-to-one audit completeness invariant required by FR-013 and SC-002.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OrphanAuditEntry { some ae: AuditEntry | no op: Operation | op.opAuditEntry = ae }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the compliance content-blindness fact allows a Permitted GetRecord operation for a ComplianceOfficer, violating FR-007 and the structural content-blindness guarantee of FR-019.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ComplianceCanReadRecord { some op: Operation | op.opCaller.role = ComplianceOfficer and op.opKind = GetRecord and op.opOutcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the patient self-access constraint allows a Patient to have a Permitted GetRecord operation on a record other than their assignedRecord, violating FR-006 and the ownership-based access invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PatientCrossRecordAccess { some op: Operation, u: User, r: Record | op.opCaller = u and u.role = Patient and op.opKind = GetRecord and op.opOutcome = Permitted and u.assignedRecord != r and op.opRecord = r }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a ClinicalNote to exist without any matching Permitted PostNote operation — i.e., a note that was never written through a legitimate, authorised operation, violating the append-only guarantee and the validation-before-mutation invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnauthorisedNote { some n: ClinicalNote | no op: Operation | op.opKind = PostNote and op.opOutcome = Permitted and op.opRecord = n.noteRecord and op.opCaller = n.noteAuthor }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the access-log gating fact allows a non-ComplianceOfficer (Clinician or Patient) to have a Permitted GetAccessLog operation, violating the compliance-officer-only rule of FR-018 and the least-privilege invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonComplianceAccessLog { some op: Operation | op.opCaller.role = Clinician and op.opKind = GetAccessLog and op.opOutcome = Permitted }
